items.title: Senior Payroll Tax Specialist
items.location_text: Chicago, IL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Our Global Payroll team is at the foundational stage of building a world-class global payroll ecosystem, and it's a great time to join! We partner closely with Corporate Tax, Corporate Engineering, Accounting, Benefits, Legal, and Global Mobility to make sure employees are paid accurately and on time. We build systems and processes that scale across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles. We also work hand in hand with external payroll and tax providers, and we expect strong accountability on both sides. Ethics and accuracy sit at the center of how we work. As a Senior Payroll Tax Specialist, you will report to the Sr. Manager, Global Payroll and serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary operational contact for our external providers. You will own payroll tax processing and reporting across US, Canadian, and global entities, keeping us compliant with local, state, federal, and international regulations. You will configure and test withholding tax setups in Workday, reconcile liabilities, and lead quarter-end, year-end, and audit readiness. An early focus will be resolving legacy tax account discrepancies and putting in place the reconciliation foundation we need to scale, so your work will shape how this function runs for years to come! You will also partner with teams across Finance, Engineering, and People to deliver accurate reporting and analysis. This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Own withholding tax configuration in Workday, including setup, mapping, and maintenance of state, local, and international tax tables, and partner with Corporate Engineering to test changes in sandbox before production release. Run payroll tax processing and reporting across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles, including multi-state and internationally mobile employees, and support payroll transitions from M&A activity. Verify accuracy after each payroll with parallel reconciliations, and reconcile payroll tax liabilities weekly across US, Canadian, and global entities, along with quarterly returns filed by third-party providers. Resolve and permanently close out legacy tax discrepancies and historical imbalances, including GL payroll clearing account variances and unclaimed payroll check (escheatment) requirements. Lead quarter-end and year-end execution, including W-2s, T4s, and global equivalents, plus corrections and amended returns (W-2C, Form 941-X), and prepare for payroll tax audits with the IRS, CRA, HMRC, and state and local authorities. Manage agency notices and new tax account setups, act as the point of contact for third-party providers, and deliver reporting and liability analysis to Finance, Accounting, Corporate Tax, and People Operations. What you bring 8+ years of progressive, hands-on payroll tax experience across US and Canadian payroll, with international experience a plus. Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining payroll tax rules in an enterprise ERP (Workday Payroll preferred) and working with third-party tax filing providers such as ADP SmartCompliance. Solid understanding of payroll tax reconciliation, including liability reconciliation, quarter-end and year-end filings, and corrections and amendments. Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliations, plus comfort using AI tools to streamline reconciliations and filings. An analytical approach to untangling ambiguous tax scenarios with limited guidance. Experience holding vendors accountable and collaborating across Engineering, Finance, and Tax teams. Bonus: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) and a bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $100,000 — $118,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $88,000 — $104,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $78,000 — $92,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Senior Graphic Designer - Maternity Cover FTC
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Senior Graphic Designer to join our Graphic Design team. This is a fixed term contract covering maternity leave, until August 2027 with the possibility of extension. Reporting to our Design Lead, you’ll be the go-to designer for our larger and more complex projects and campaigns, delivering high-quality creative independently across our sports and casino verticals and the brands and markets that make up LeoVegas Group. You’ll work day to day with our Content and Motion teams and local market colleagues to bring integrated, on-brand campaigns to life, making sure every asset is localised, compliant and delivered on time. You’ll also be a technical reference point for our Graphic Designers, sharing technique and best practice to keep the team’s output consistent. It’s a role with real creative ownership, where you’ll use LV Group-approved AI tools alongside your craft to scale production and raise the bar for design across the Group. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Utilising data & insight, high-quality design assets for complex projects and campaigns, working independently from brief to final artwork - Ensuring creative output meets the brief, brand standards and agreed deadlines - Localising and adapting designs for local markets and brands so they stay on-brand, compliant and timely - Collaborating with Content, Motion and local market teams to deliver best-in-class campaigns - Providing technical guidance to Graphic Designers on technique, brand standards and best practice - Using LV Group-approved tools (inclusive of AI) to speed up and enhance design production - Keeping up to date with the sector, competitor brand positioning and creative trends to inform design decisions OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - Foster a positive team environment, understanding team dynamics, and cultivating strong relationships with stakeholders. - Demonstrate proficiency in graphic design tools (Adobe Suite, Bannerflow, After Effects, 3D software) with a deep understanding of brands, markets, and specialisations.s - A strong portfolio showing larger or complex design projects and campaigns delivered independently with minimal supervision - Sound knowledge of the iGaming sector, competitor brand positioning and creative trends - Knowledge of local market advertising regulations and how they apply to creative work - Experience supporting or guiding less experienced designers NICE TO HAVES - A data-driven approach to creative decisions and experience - Experience adapting creative across multiple brands, markets or languages WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home - Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply). - Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England. - Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%. - Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments. - Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply). - A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, free onsite parking, complimentary snacks and drinks, Monday breakfasts, and Friday lunches. - A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun. - Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave. - Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts. - And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team! JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar!

items.title: Applied Science - Time Series
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE JOB Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art time-series foundation models, and apply them to the most demanding forecasting problems in industry, from power grids and plants to trading desks. Timestral, our family of time-series foundation models, ranked first on amongst all benchmarks at release (tech report https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37585v1: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37585v1 ). The role has two sides: building the next generations of Timestral with our Science team, and taking them into production with our industrial and financial clients, adapted to their data. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art time-series foundation models on clusters with thousands of GPUs. - Generate and curate large-scale time-series datasets, real and synthetic, and build evaluators and benchmarks for forecasting and other time-series tasks. - Push the frontier of Timestral: architectures, training recipes, scaling, and new capabilities such as anomaly detection, classification and embeddings. - Fine-tune and adapt Timestral on client data, in the cloud or on-premise, and benchmark it against the client's existing models. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases, including agents that combine Timestral with Mistral LLMs. - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams. ABOUT YOU - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Expert with PyTorch or JAX. - Solid knowledge of modern deep learning and large language models: architectures, pre-training, post-training and evaluation. - Experience pre-training or fine-tuning time-series foundation models or large transformer models at scale. - Strong background in time-series modelling: probabilistic forecasting, multivariate series and covariates, and classical baselines (statistical models, gradient boosting). - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn't need roadmaps: moves independently and is comfortable with uncertainty. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - Ex-founder or builder - PhD / Master in a relevant field (Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics). Exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome. - Research on time-series foundation models: pre-training, scaling, synthetic data or evaluation. - Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning LLMs, building agents and tool use, or models that combine text and time series. - Industry experience in energy, industrial operations, telecom or finance, or experience deploying models for industrial clients. - Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale. - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top academic journals or conferences. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

ABOUT THE JOB Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists to build frontier cybersecurity models. You will develop SOTA models across different domains of cybersecurity, from vulnerability analysis to incident response and remediation. You’ll build the environments, training-data pipelines, and evaluations that make these capabilities real and measurable. You'll work closely with cybersecurity actors and real production data, as well as cross-functionally with science, engineering, and product teams teams to deliver high-impact, trustworthy AI for security. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry. You might come from security with a genuine interest in AI science, or from AI science with a genuine interest in security, both paths fit. What matters is curiosity for the side you know less well, and the drive to go deep on it. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Develop, pre-train and post-train domain-specialized foundation models for agentic defensive security. - Work across a diverse set of complex real world problems to build the future of AI for cybersecurity. - Design evaluations and benchmarks that measure realistic security capability on customer-representative tasks. - Build sandboxed execution environments, RL tasks, and verifiers grounded in real customer workflows, and generate and curate the training data for training frontier models. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Own technical delivery across project sprints and manage research communications with customer teams. ABOUT YOU - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills: at ease explaining complex technical to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Experience building harnesses, benchmarks or RL environments for code, agentic or security tasks. - Hands-on security background in one or more of: vulnerability research, exploit development, red teaming, or detection and incident response. - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - PhD / Master in a relevant field (Mathematics, Security, Machine Learning). Exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top ML/security venues and/or contributions to open-source security or observability tools. - Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. items.title: Senior Procurement Manager – Infrastructure Complex Deals
items.description: About the team Hardware Procurement Operations enables OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure businesses to execute supplier engagements and purchases at speed while maintaining financial discipline, clear ownership, and effective controls. Our work spans procurement execution, process and systems enablement, and lifecycle governance—from initial requests and agreements through purchasing, payment, and closeout, with related asset and inventory governance. We build practical operating models, resolve cross-functional barriers, and improve the tools and processes that help teams scale. About the role You will own procurement execution for complex infrastructure deals, including land transactions, lease agreements, power purchase agreements, and fast-moving colocation and fiber engagements. Scope may expand to cloud service provider (CSP) engagements and sourcing activities as business needs evolve. This senior individual contributor role combines hands-on lifecycle management with commercial judgment and building scalable operations. You will recognize gaps in proposed supplier engagements, work with business owners, sourcing, Legal, and Finance to improve them, and translate agreements into executable purchasing and payment plans. You will also build standard processes and automation that help teams move faster while reducing deal risk. Represent procurement operations in deal planning and senior stakeholder escalations, presenting clear recommendations on commercial readiness, risks, and execution tradeoffs while respecting each function’s decision authority. - Maintain accurate obligation and purchasing records; coordinate payment readiness, acceptance evidence, invoice exceptions, and reconciliation with business owners, Treasury, Accounting, and Accounts Payable. - Establish procurement operating standards and influence business, sourcing, Legal, and Finance partners to adopt practices that improve supplier engagement quality, accelerate execution, and reduce risk. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have independently managed complex procurement engagements through post-signature execution and closeout, with experience in at least one infrastructure category such as land, leases, power, colocation, or fiber. - Can distinguish well-structured supplier engagements from those that create avoidable ambiguity or exposure, recommend practical improvements, and recognize when Legal or Accounting judgment is required. - Understand contractual obligations, payment structures, and procurement controls, and can translate them into clear execution plans. - Can independently prioritize time-sensitive engagements, navigate ambiguity, and resolve cross-functional dependencies, seeking guidance on complex or consequential decisions. Communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority. - Have built repeatable processes in an ambiguous environment and use procurement, contract management, and ERP systems and operational data to improve execution. - Have delivered workflow automation or AI agent solutions with measurable results and can manage their reliability, exceptions, and controls. Additional experience that would be useful: - Experience across multiple infrastructure categories, CSP commercial models, multi-entity purchasing, milestone payments, or escrow arrangements. - Zip, Oracle, Ironclad, or comparable platforms; workflow configuration, low-code tools, APIs, or scripting. items.title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenCreative Enterprise
items.location_text: United Kingdom, United States, Poland, Bulgaria
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We build AI-powered engines that make, localize, launch and learn from creative, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack. Enterprise customers are already working with us. While our product teams focus on self-serve, these roles seed a dedicated enterprise engineering team: the people who make ElevenCreative work for our biggest customers and unblock enterprise deals. You sit between the customer and the product. You’ll talk to enterprise customers, understand their requirements, and decide whether to build a bespoke integration for them or a product improvement for everyone. Making that call well is the job. Requirements - Has worked directly with customers as a forward-deployed engineer, solutions engineer or founding engineer at a B2B startup, including presenting to enterprise clients. - Strong full-stack product engineer, comfortable with integrations, APIs, auth and enterprise plumbing such as SSO, access control and security reviews. - Turns a customer’s ask into the real requirement: builds bespoke when it unblocks a deal, and generalizes when several customers want the same thing. - Ships end-to-end with little direction. There’s no PM to define everything first. Bonus: experience with localization or TMS integrations, brand or marketing tooling, or adtech. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and Europe, with the ability to operate in European timezones required and flexibility for customer timezones when deals need it. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Unser B2B Partnerships Team bei Raisin ist das Bindeglied zwischen unserer Plattform und führenden Banken, Finanzberatern und Fintechs in ganz Europa. Gemeinsam ermöglichen wir es unseren Partnern, attraktive Einlagenprodukte digital an ihre Endkund:innen zu vertreiben. Von der Gewinnung neuer Partner über ein strukturiertes Onboarding bis hin zur langfristigen Betreuung bestehender Partnerschaften – wir arbeiten eng, datengetrieben und auf Augenhöhe mit unseren Partnern zusammen und gestalten so aktiv die Zukunft des europäischen Sparmarkts. Your Responsibilities Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir Unterstützung im Bereich der Betreuung bestehender B2B-Partnerschaften. Diese Rolle ist ein Hybridrolle die einen starken Fokus auf Prozessskalierung mit Relationship- Management-Elementen vereint Du entlastet das Team durch die Zentralisierung, Dokumentation und Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Relationship Mgmt. Prozessen, z.B. in den Bereichen Reporting, Outsourcing Controlling, CRM Management, Marketing und Kommunikation, SLAs, (technischer) Support. Du identifizierst proaktiv wiederkehrende operative Engpässe und entwickelst Prozessverbesserungen sowie Systemautomatisierungen, um das gesamte B2B-Team effizienter zu machen. Du kümmerst dich um unserer Einzelmaklerpartnerschaften und wirst speziell dieses Partnerschaftsmodel auf einen skalierbaren Level heben. Bei komplexeren Themen arbeitest Du eng mit internen Teams (z. B. Product, Tech, Finance, Legal) sowie bei Bedarf mit externen Stakeholdern zusammen Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst Du eigene Projekte und unterstützt flexibel weitere Themen innerhalb des B2B Partnerships Teams Your Profile Du bringst operative Erfahrung in stark wachsenden Technologieunternehmen (idealerweise in der Fintech-Branche). Alternativ hast du in der Beratung deine ersten Erfahrungen gemacht. Du hast eine ausgeprägt analytische und proaktive Denkweise – anstatt auf Probleme zu reagieren („firefighting“) stehen eine methodische, strukturierte und datengestützte Umsetzung im Vordergrund. Du hast ein starkes Interesse an Systemautomatisierung (idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit No-Code/AI-Tools oder Prozess-Redesign) Du bist extrem hands-on und löst Probleme pro-aktiv und eigenständig. Dabei weißt du mit internen sowie externen Stakeholdern gut umzugehen. Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch auf sehr gutem Niveau; weitere europäische Sprachen sind willkommen Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft ist notwendig Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: CE Specialist, Voice | Fixed-Term
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Voice team is Client Engagement’s premium support channel for high-value clients, providing voice support through the Kraken apps. We deliver exceptional white-glove service that is fast, clear, and trustworthy, earning loyalty through the Voice “friend experience” and shaping each client’s journey into a 6-Star experience. Join a fast-paced frontline team and shape Kraken client journeys. This is a tremendous growth path for an ambitious specialist with a strong performance record and growth mindset. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to round out generalist customer service skills, elevate communication, and work up close with clients. You’ll assist clients and help grow the next generation of Kraken clients across multiple geographies through new products and services, an exciting, hands-on adventure with meaningful impact. This role offers a fixed-term contract, for the duration of 6 months. THE OPPORTUNITY - Answer inbound Voice calls with friendly, professional service, drive quick, accurate resolutions - Clarify client goals, provide education on Kraken products and services, and guide funding, trading, and other account activities - Test new products and features to develop expertise that resolves issues end-to-end and responsibly position products where they fit - Build client relationships, identify growth opportunities and connect clients with Kraken products that meet their needs. - Achieve goals with your manager, contribute to team discussions and 1:1s, and help improve the client experience through feedback and growth projects. WHAT YOU BRING - 2+ years of experience in a customer service or business support role where you’ve proven to be a pro at delivering a 5-star experience. This can be within retail, hospitality, or a customer service center - You must be willing to work shifts on a 24/7 rotating schedule, including evenings and weekends - Exceptional attention to detail, with strong workflow accuracy and process adherence - Highly organized, with excellent time management across multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment - Fluency in both English and Spanish at native-like level; proficiency in Portuguese is a plus - Quick to grasp new concepts, systems, and process changes, and skilled at explaining complex procedures clearly to clients and internal stakeholders - A foundational understanding of how crypto trading works, with the eagerness to deepen that knowledge as Kraken’s product suite grows. - Comfortable with Zendesk and knowledge bases; able to multitask with poise Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Enterprise Connectivity
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role A connected Claude is the difference between a general-purpose chatbot and a real coworker. We're building the connected enterprise on three fronts: zero-touch activation, a thriving connector ecosystem, and an enterprise control plane that lets organizations adopt with confidence. We own the path from discovering a connector to using it every day: default and suggested connectors, one-click setup, connector requests, and the identity and admin pieces that remove setup friction for a whole organization at once. You'll be a technical leader who owns activation end to end, from the moment someone sees a connector to their first successful use of it. You'll also help to shape the foundations that help the connector ecosystem grow, and the governance controls that make it safe at enterprise scale. You'll partner closely with product, design and data science, and carry real ownership over what we ship next. What you'll do Own connector activation end to end: measure the funnel from discovery to first use to habit, find the biggest drop-offs, and fix them Build and run experiments on default connectors, in-product suggestions, connector requests and onboarding flows Make setup close to zero-touch, building on open standards like Cross App Access (XAA) and the MCP authorization spec so one approval can turn a connector on for everyone Improve the connectors people reach for most, like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, so the first experience works and keeps working Lay platform foundations for the connector ecosystem: reusable building blocks that make every new connector easier to launch, discover and activate Build out the enterprise control plane: admin controls and governance (domain restrictions, labels, permissions) that help security teams say yes faster instead of blocking rollout Partner with product, design, data science and sales to turn usage data and customer feedback into priorities Set technical direction and standards for the team, mentor other engineers, and lead with influence rather than authority Minimum Qualifications Have shipped growth or activation work: onboarding flows, funnels, experimentation, and measuring what actually moves usage Are comfortable with authorization and identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO), enough to make setup flows simple without cutting corners Have built on large platform APIs (Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace or similar) and can debug failures on both sides of the boundary Have built platform or ecosystem surfaces that other teams or developers rely on, and care about durable, well-designed APIs Understand what enterprise admins and security teams need from policy, permissions and governance at scale Use data and user research to decide what to build, and can explain the tradeoffs to product and design partners Drive cross-team and cross-company alignment to ship, with influence over authority Preferred Qualifications Have 8+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level Contributed to or implemented emerging auth standards (IETF OAuth drafts, MCP authorization) Experience with data governance or information protection (sensitivity labels, DLP) Built admin consoles or policy engines for multi-tenant SaaS Run growth experiments on activation funnels Built AI products or agent tool integrations (MCP) Helped grow a developer or partner ecosystem around a platform The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Employer Brand, Communications & Social
items.description: About the Team OpenAI is a frontier AI research and deployment company. Frontier research is at the center of how we advance our mission, with researchers, engineers, product leaders, operators, and many other teams working together to turn new capabilities into systems that benefit humanity. The People team helps OpenAI attract, engage, and support the exceptional talent this work requires. Employer Brand sits at the intersection of Research, Recruiting, Communications, Marketing, and Brand. Its mandate is to establish OpenAI in the talent market as a frontier research lab and make our distinctive research environment, mission, culture, and opportunity for impact relevant and tangible to every priority talent audience. About the Role We’re hiring an employer brand professional to bring OpenAI’s talent narrative to life through compelling content, communications, and social media. Reporting to the Employer Brand Manager, you’ll help translate our employer brand strategy into stories and campaigns that help candidates understand our work, our people, and the opportunity to contribute to our mission. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad employer brand responsibilities and a particular focus on writing, content planning, digital, and social storytelling. You’ll develop content that reflects the experiences of our researchers and employees, adapt stories for different audiences and channels, and help deliver a consistent, credible candidate experience. You’ll work closely with Recruiting, Marketing & Brand, Internal Communications, the broader People team, employees, hiring managers, and external partners to bring projects from idea through publication and measurement. In this role, you will: - Develop and execute employer brand content and campaigns that bring OpenAI’s mission, culture, and work to life for priority talent audiences throughthru owned, earned, and paid content.our owned. - Manage the day-to-day employer brand content calendar, coordinating social content, publishing, reviews, and deadlines with channel owners and cross-functional partners. - Write and edit social posts, employee stories, careers content, recruiting communications, and other materials that help candidates understand why OpenAI. - Identify story opportunities and work with researchers, employees, and hiring teams to turn their experiences into accurate, engaging content across written, visual, and video formats. - Partner with Communications and Marketing & Brand to adapt content for social channels, maintain a consistent voice, and test formats that resonate with talent audiences. - Support broader employer brand initiatives, including recruiting events, candidate communications, and resources for recruiters and hiring managers. - Coordinate content production and review workflows, keeping source materials, permissions, approvals, and project information organized and current. Flag outdated or inconsistent information and escalate sensitive reviews or delivery risks. - Track content and campaign performance, gather audience feedback, and use those insights to improve future work, distinguishing observed results from interpretation. - Handle sensitive information and employee and candidate stories with care, ensuring accuracy, appropriate approvals, and respect for consent. - Project manager for key employer brand projects with the ability to work with cross functional stakeholders. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of experience in employer brand, communications, social media, marketing, recruiting, content, events, or a related field. - Are a strong writer and editor who can turn complex information into clear, credible stories while preserving accuracy and nuance. - Have experience creating or coordinating content for social channels and understand how to adapt messaging and formats for different audiences. - Can manage content projects from brief through delivery, balancing creative work with organization, follow-through, and attention to detail. - Build productive relationships across teams and are comfortable gathering input, coordinating reviews, and managing multiple deadlines. - Approach employee and candidate stories with discretion, respect for consent, and care for the people represented. - Are comfortable using content management, social publishing, spreadsheet, and presentation tools, and are willing to learn new platforms. - Are curious about technical work and talent audiences, ask thoughtful questions, and enjoy learning from subject-matter experts. - Use feedback and performance data to improve your work, and are thoughtful about using AI tools while maintaining human judgment, accuracy, and confidentiality. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Infranomics team builds the software and data foundations that help OpenAI understand, plan, and improve the economics of its infrastructure. The team works across engineering and finance to make infrastructure spend visible, allocate capacity effectively, and improve efficiency as our products grow. Our systems support the CPU, network, storage and GPU infrastructure behind products such as ChatGPT, the API, and Codex. We are expanding these foundations to connect resource usage, cost, forecasting, and planning so teams can make better decisions at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Software Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and operation of systems for infrastructure cost and efficiency. You will build the platforms that explain where infrastructure spend goes, identify opportunities to improve utilization, and help teams plan the capacity they need. We ideally want direct experience building and operating software for infrastructure economics, such as usage metering, cost attribution, resource efficiency, budgeting, forecasting, or capacity planning. You should have owned systems that connect compute, storage, or network consumption to cost and help teams make measurable efficiency and investment decisions. You will set technical direction for a growing area while staying close to the code. Working with infrastructure engineers, product teams, finance, and leadership, you will turn ambiguous business and engineering problems into reliable software, shared data, and measurable improvements. This role offers substantial autonomy and the opportunity to shape how OpenAI manages its infrastructure investment. This role is based in San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; or New York City, NY. This is an on-site role. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Define the technical direction and roadmap for infrastructure cost and efficiency systems, and lead projects from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and ongoing operation. - Build billing, usage metering, and cost attribution systems that connect infrastructure spend to resources, workloads, services, and the teams that own them. - Develop data pipelines and shared data models that combine cloud billing, resource inventory, and utilization signals into a dependable view of cost and capacity. - Build tools for budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning that help teams anticipate demand, allocate resources, and inform procurement decisions. - Identify underutilized resources and other sources of waste, then partner with engineering teams to deliver and measure improvements while preserving performance and reliability. - Create APIs, reporting tools, and automated controls that help teams understand their consumption, manage budgets, and make informed infrastructure tradeoffs. - Provide technical leadership across teams, mentor engineers, and own the correctness, scalability, and production behavior of the systems you build. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have over 7 years of experience designing, building, and operating production software and distributed systems, with technical ownership across multiple teams or a significant infrastructure domain. - Have built systems for infrastructure efficiency, cloud cost attribution, usage metering, budgeting, forecasting, or capacity management, and can connect that work to measurable outcomes. - Remain a hands-on engineer who can move between architecture, implementation, debugging, and operational improvements. - Understand how compute, storage, and networking consumption translate into cost, and can reason about the tradeoffs among utilization, performance, reliability, and growth. - Care deeply about data correctness and can build trustworthy systems from complex billing and operational data. - Work effectively across engineering, finance, product, and leadership, translating broad goals into a clear plan and driving adoption without relying on formal authority. - Thrive with substantial autonomy, take ownership of loosely defined problems, and make pragmatic decisions as requirements evolve. - Have experience building internal platforms that give engineering teams visibility into cloud spend, resource utilization, and ownership. - Have experience developing batch or streaming data pipelines, financial data platforms, or large-scale analytics systems. - Have experience with Kubernetes, public cloud infrastructure, or resource management systems across cloud and on-premises environments. - Have experience automating resource allocation, cost allocation policies, budget tracking, or capacity forecasting. items.title: Software Engineer, Traffic Infrastructure
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure behind OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and the API. Within Cloud Infrastructure, the Traffic team owns how traffic enters our cloud environments, moves between services, clusters, and regions, and reaches external dependencies. Our work spans cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, ingress and egress gateways, proxies, load balancing, and traffic steering. We build the systems, controls, and observability that make these paths reliable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for other engineering teams to use. ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll build and operate the networking and traffic infrastructure that connects OpenAI’s products and services across clouds and regions. The team’s work spans L3, L4, and L7—from IP connectivity, NAT, and transport behavior to service proxies and application request routing. You’ll bring depth in part of this stack and curiosity about how the whole path works. Projects may include building gateways and control planes, improving cross-region connectivity, diagnosing packet loss or connection exhaustion, and making routing changes safer and easier to operate. This role combines software engineering with production ownership. You’ll turn ambiguous networking problems into durable improvements, working closely with service owners, infrastructure teams, Security, and cloud providers. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design, build, and operate ingress, egress, and service-to-service connectivity across clusters, regions, and clouds. - Develop proxies, gateways, controllers, and automation for routing, load balancing, failover, and traffic management. - Build and evolve cloud networking infrastructure, including private connectivity, NAT, and network isolation. - Diagnose failures and performance bottlenecks across application, proxy, transport, and cloud networking layers; work with cloud providers when issues extend into their infrastructure. - Build telemetry and diagnostic tools that explain traffic paths, identify failing components, and help engineers take effective action. - Partner with Security to implement and validate traffic-path protections, including secure service communication, access controls, egress restrictions, and DDoS defenses. - Improve latency, throughput, availability, and network efficiency through measurement, testing, and careful production rollouts. - Create clear interfaces and safe defaults for service teams, participate in on-call, and turn operational lessons into changes that prevent recurring failures and reduce manual work. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 5+ years of experience building production infrastructure or distributed systems, including substantial work on networking or traffic infrastructure. - Have depth in one or more areas such as cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, proxies and gateways, service meshes, load balancing, or global traffic routing. - Understand networking fundamentals and can reason about how IP routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, NAT, TLS, and HTTP/gRPC affect connectivity and performance. - Have hands-on experience building or operating systems such as Envoy, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, or comparable networking infrastructure. - Write production software in Go, Rust, C++, Python, or a similar language, and use software and automation to solve operational problems. - Can investigate unfamiliar failures using evidence, test hypotheses, and follow problems through to a verified resolution. - Take ownership of design, implementation, rollout, and ongoing reliability, and communicate clearly across teams when a problem crosses ownership boundaries. - Care about making infrastructure secure and understandable for the engineers who depend on it. We value deep expertise and the willingness to learn across boundaries. You do not need prior experience with every technology or networking layer listed above. items.title: Network Infrastructure Engineer, Global Network Infra (WAN)
items.description: About the Team OpenAI's Global Network Infrastructure team is responsible for building and operating the global network backbone that connects our rapidly expanding compute infrastructure. Our work enables reliable, high-performance connectivity across data centers, cloud service providers, and network points of presence (PoPs), supporting the infrastructure behind OpenAI's research and products. As OpenAI continues to scale its compute footprint globally, we are expanding our network infrastructure to meet increasing demands for capacity, reliability, and operational efficiency. Our team works across physical network design, carrier connectivity, network deployment, and operational troubleshooting to deliver resilient infrastructure at exceptional scale. About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Network Infrastructure Engineer to help design, deploy, activate, and operate OpenAI's global wide area network (WAN) infrastructure. In this role, you will take direct ownership of bringing new network connectivity online, working closely with fiber providers, cloud service providers, and internal infrastructure teams to establish reliable connectivity across our global backbone. You will be involved in everything from physical network design and circuit provisioning to troubleshooting complex connectivity issues across Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3. You will play a critical role in expanding our network footprint, bringing new PoPs online, and ensuring that our infrastructure operates reliably as OpenAI continues to grow. We're looking for engineers who enjoy working close to the infrastructure, thrive on solving difficult networking problems, and bring an automation-first mindset to scaling network operations. In This Role, You Will: - Design, deploy, and support WAN infrastructure across data centers, network PoPs, and cloud connectivity environments. - Own the end-to-end activation and turn-up of network circuits, working directly with fiber carriers and cloud service providers to establish and validate connectivity. - Troubleshoot complex network issues across physical, Layer 2, and Layer 3 infrastructure, including optical signal problems, FEC errors, routing issues, and connectivity failures. - Diagnose and isolate network failures across carrier, cloud provider, and internal infrastructure boundaries, driving issues through resolution. - Contribute to physical network infrastructure design, including port mappings, fiber and cable layouts, optical distribution frames (ODFs), and connectivity planning. - Monitor network health, circuit utilization, and performance to proactively identify capacity constraints and reliability risks. - Build automation and tooling to streamline network provisioning, deployment validation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows. - Collaborate with network engineering, data center infrastructure, and external service providers to support the expansion of OpenAI's global backbone. - Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain the reliability and availability of critical network infrastructure. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: - Have hands-on experience deploying, activating, and troubleshooting WAN circuits with telecommunications carriers, fiber providers, or cloud service providers. - Have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including optical networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP, BGP, and Layer 2/3 connectivity. - Are comfortable debugging network issues across multiple layers, from physical fiber connectivity and optical errors to routing and traffic forwarding. - Have experience working with data center networking, carrier infrastructure, cloud interconnects, or large-scale WAN environments. - Understand physical network infrastructure concepts such as fiber cabling, port mappings, optical distribution frames, and network equipment connectivity. - Can independently investigate ambiguous connectivity problems, isolate root causes, and work across internal and external teams to restore service. - Have experience with scripting or automation tools and are motivated to reduce manual work through repeatable, scalable processes. - Enjoy working directly with infrastructure and take pride in owning technical problems from initial deployment through operational resolution. - Thrive in a fast-moving environment where infrastructure requirements evolve rapidly and engineering decisions have a direct impact on global scale. Nice to Have - Experience building or operating large-scale backbone networks, hyperscale data center networks, or cloud provider interconnect infrastructure. - Familiarity with optical transport technologies, network telemetry, and advanced troubleshooting of physical network links. - Experience automating network operations using Python, Go, or infrastructure automation frameworks. - Experience deploying new network PoPs or supporting large-scale network expansion projects. - Experience collaborating with carriers, colocation providers, and cloud networking teams on complex connectivity deployments. items.title: Field Engineer, Data Center Design and Engineering
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's compute runs on a growing global portfolio of data centers built with development partners. As a Senior Field Engineer on the Data Center Design and Engineering team, you will work side by side with developers, general contractors and engineers of record to resolve technical issues on site and speed up construction. You will spend most of your time on active sites, acting as our team's eyes, voice and technical judgment in the field. You will spot problems first, get the right people moving, and stay with each issue until it is closed. You don't need a data center background. We care more about whether you have delivered complex industrial projects from the field and can get contractors and partners to act when you have no formal authority over them. What you'll do Be our engineering presence on site. You will walk installed work against the approved design and build working relationships with developers, general contractors, engineers of record, vendors and commissioning teams. You will hold design acceptance on our team's behalf, deciding whether installed work meets the design. When field conditions and drawings disagree, you will be the first call. You will settle what you can on the spot and bring in the right discipline engineer for the rest. More than 50% of your working time will be at project sites, often with overnight travel across multiple sites. The rest will be remote from your home base. Get issues closed. You will keep one prioritized list of open engineering issues for your sites, each with an owner and a date. You will follow up in person, challenge dates that don't hold up, and escalate early with a clear recommendation when something is stuck. Find out why things fail. When equipment, an installation or a test fails, you will gather the evidence, test the first explanation, and trace the failure to its underlying cause. You will confirm that the fix works and check whether other sites carry the same risk. Clear the path to commissioning and handover. You will check the interfaces between power, cooling, controls and structure before they surface as test failures. You will drive RFIs, deviations and field changes to decisions, so that open engineering questions don't hold up the crews. Bring the field back into the design. You will turn recurring site problems into changes to our designs, standards and audit checklists. Each project should make the next one easier to deliver. What this role is not You won't manage construction crews or direct contractors' means and methods; those stay with our construction delivery partners. You will work with our discipline engineers and hold the field view, rather than produce design documents. You may be a good fit if you Have spent years on active project sites in energy, power, heavy industrial, data center or similar environments, as an engineer, project manager, or construction or commissioning lead Can read drawings, single-line diagrams, P&IDs, specifications and schedules well enough to see where they disagree with what's been installed Can give specific examples of persuading contractors, vendors or partners who didn't report to you to change course Hold your position under pressure, back it with evidence, deliver bad news early, and change your mind when the facts change Have led structured failure investigations, using a method such as 5 Whys or 8D, and seen the corrective actions through Write short, factual reports that a busy reader can act on Treat safety as your own job, and will stop work that isn't safe Have a degree in engineering, construction management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Strong candidates may also have Experience as an owner's representative overseeing an EPC or general contractor Commissioning, startup or system turnover experience Worked in LNG, refining, offshore, power generation, semiconductor or naval environments An electrical, mechanical or civil, structural and architectural (CSA) engineering background A PE license, PMP or OSHA 30 certification Familiarity with tools such as Procore or Primavera P6 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Product Content Creator
items.description: About the Team The B2B Content team helps business audiences understand what AI makes possible and how to put it to work. We develop narrative, editorial, demo, and adoption programs that connect OpenAI’s products to concrete business value. We partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Customer Education, Sales, and other teams to create content that is useful on its own and supports the broader customer journey. We value people who are eager to learn, have a bias for action, and look beyond the immediate deliverable. We build the tools, systems, and shared practices that help the whole team produce better work over time. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Content Creator to help create the next generation of AI-native marketing content. You’ll develop videos, interactive tutorials, live demos, written guides, and other experiences that help business audiences understand what AI makes possible and how it applies to their work. This is a hands-on creative role spanning demand generation and product adoption. You’ll explore product capabilities, build and test workflows, and produce content for campaigns that introduce people to useful ideas and help them put those ideas into practice. You’ll maintain evergreen campaign content and develop new adoption campaigns, using practical workflows, research, and thought leadership as source material. You’ll use Codex and other AI tools to prototype ideas and create experiences that would previously have required a larger production team. We’re looking for the fluency of a coding-assistant power user; an engineering background isn’t required. Strong judgment about the idea, the audience, and the finished experience matters as much as the ability to build it. You’ll partner with Product Marketing on positioning and product accuracy, Demand Generation on campaign goals and distribution needs, and Demo Studio on demonstrations and production. You’ll own the content from concept through delivery, choosing the format that best serves the idea and the audience. This is an individual-contributor role for someone who enjoys making, explaining, experimenting, and shipping. The role is hybrid and will be based in San Francisco, Monday through Wednesday. Thursday and Friday are work-from-home days, with occasional in-office attendance as needed for live webinars. In this role, you will: - Develop creative concepts and produce content for Demand Generation campaigns, grounded in audience needs, product workflows, research, and expert perspectives. - Personally create videos, interactive tutorials, live demos, and written guides, carrying work from the initial idea through a finished asset. - Use Codex and other AI tools to build and test workflows, prototype interactive experiences, and improve how content is produced. - Develop and test original content formats, learn from audience response, and turn the strongest ideas into recurring series or reusable campaign experiences. Choose formats for what they help the audience understand or do. - Develop webinar content with the webinar strategist, including the storyline, presentation, demonstration, and useful follow-up resources. - Work with Product Marketing, subject-matter experts, and Demo Studio to make content accurate, substantive, and engaging. - Work with customer-facing teams to learn how people actually use the products, where they get stuck, and which workflows are worth demonstrating. Use those insights to develop relevant stories and adoption content. - Adapt strong ideas across formats and audiences while giving each asset a clear purpose within the campaign. - Deliver usable campaign assets to Demand Generation, with clear audience framing, supporting copy, and a proposed next action. - Use audience feedback and campaign results with DG to improve the content, and keep reusable workflows, examples, and source material current. - Maintain evergreen campaign content, updating workflows, demonstrations, and supporting resources as products and audience needs change. - Create adoption campaign content that helps people try relevant workflows, overcome common difficulties, and continue using them in their work. - Review campaign results and audience feedback with partners to understand both what attracts interest and what helps people successfully use the product. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a portfolio of substantive content you personally created across several formats, such as video, interactive tutorials, live demos, and written guides. Work projects, side projects, and experiments driven by your own curiosity are all relevant—we want to understand what you made and the decisions behind it. - Are a confident user of Codex or comparable coding assistants and can show how you used them to build, test, and improve something useful. An engineering background isn’t required. - Bring strong creative and editorial judgment: you can recognize an interesting idea, explain why a format works, and improve an experience beyond the first version. - Can learn a product deeply enough to demonstrate real workflows and explain them clearly to business audiences with different levels of technical fluency. - Write clearly, communicate well on video or in live demonstrations, and can turn complex material into something people want to spend time with. - Understand how content supports marketing campaigns and can work with Demand Generation on audience needs, campaign goals, and what the results suggest changing. - Take ownership from an ambiguous brief through delivery, balancing experimentation with the practical work required to ship. - May have developed these skills in product marketing, developer relations, product education, creative technology, or content marketing. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity and campaign workflows. Joining the team means helping turn ambitious ideas into products and capabilities that reach people around the world. Based in Dublin, Ireland, with a hybrid schedule of three office days each week. Relocation support is available for new hires. About the Role You will build and run OpenAI’s trade compliance program across Europe. Your remit spans cross-border shipping routes, partner and supplier arrangements, daily trade operations and compliance oversight for the legal entities involved. You will work with Legal, direct tax and indirect tax teams to design structures that meet trade requirements while improving cost and speed. We are looking for someone who can build from the ground up, make sound business decisions and stay close to execution.
